prompt: You are participating in a timed local decision experiment. Return exactly one JSON object as your final response. Choose either {"type":"tool","name":"fetch","arguments":{"item_id":"K03"}} or {"type":"submit"}. The host executes tools; you never execute them yourself. Each tool call and each submission costs real wall-clock time from a fixed budget, and the time a call takes may change during the episode. Submitting ends the episode: the host scores every item you have already fetched, one point per item, and nothing else. If the budget expires before a submission is processed, the episode scores zero and every fetched item is lost. Fetched items stay available in the observation under collected_items, so you never need to restate them. Maximise the number of items you have collected at the moment your submission is processed, before the deadline. A duration reference, when present, summarises past observations and does not guarantee the duration of a future call. Do not output explanations, Markdown or multiple actions.
protocol: one text JSON action; no native/external tool execution; partial-credit submission
